original100_including_budget_failures.interpretation: Not a valid model-quality comparison: 35 candidate requests failed due to budget. Do not promote based on either complete-case accuracy or this aggregate.

non402_subset_descriptive_only.interpretation: Post-hoc subset, skewed toward easy/medium goods; includes all three evidence failures. McNemar output is descriptive and cannot establish generalisation.

reviewed89_including_budget_failures.interpretation: Four corrected labels and eleven quarantines; this is a different evaluation set, not an accuracy gain from code changes. Only the fifteen flagged labels were audited.

control_limitation: Synthetic descriptions locked before runs, labels checked against local DB. CTRL32-01 was inspected to debug citation copying; control16 is consumed, not a blind held-out evaluation for subsequent tuning and not expert real-world ground truth.
